text_block_list.name: Old Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text:
It might be the last time you'll get, so
take your
time and tell her everything
you've been up to.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Don't let go before me, Teach. Please...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Give me one more chance. I'll definitely
win at the
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't freak out. Aren't we good
friends?
choice_data_list: えっ、シリウスシンボリ！？

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The higher the hopes, the more painful
the fall.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You haven't forgotten, have you? The
despair
that Umamusume caused after
showing us a
glimpse of something so
beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Everyone works themselves into a frenzy,

enamored by a dream, only to turn on a
dime and
chicken out.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Afraid to feel the same disappointment
twice
over.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
In the beginning, they couldn't contain

themselves, but now they're totally
silent, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think I've caught on to what she's
pointing out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Prix de l'Arc de
Triomphe last
year, a wide range of
media outlets all covered
the race, each
from its own perspective.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But when it comes to the media
coverage for this
year's Prix de l'Arc de
Triomphe...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
And don't go thinking it's because no
Japanese
Umamusume is planning to run.
choice_data_list: 去年よりもずっと少なかった

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Their love for Paris has faded now that
their
affection isn't reciprocated.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: It's ridiculous...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It all ends once you've lost your fighting
spirit!
Afterwards, you'll just get
trampled under the
weight of the strong!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. You're optimistic.
choice_data_list: 彼女は蹂躙される側にはならない

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Kikuka Sho. I'm doing
the final
checks with Nakayama Festa in
the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You're being unusually thorough today.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...You're right.
choice_data_list: 三冠路線最後のレースだから

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
This is my last chance to prove my
strength. I
can't waste it.
